description: AsyncAPI event channels across the catalog. Individual event channels (topics/streams). Filter by q / tags / providers; include=["content"] inlines bodies. Use find_artifacts for cross-type search.

context.description: Optional: one sentence on why you are asking. Never used to rank; read only if a result is wrong.

include.description: Pass ["content"] to inline each artifact's body instead of just its URL.

protocol.description: Transport the channel runs over: ws, http, sse, kafka, mqtt, amqp, nats, grpc… Empty where the document never says, which is most of them.

q.description: Free text over name + description, e.g. "sms".

sort.description: Order: relevance (catalog order), provider, or name.

tags.description: Tag slugs, e.g. ["payments"]. On providers: what the company does (see api_tags).

version.description: AsyncAPI spec version the channel is defined in, e.g. 2.6.0 or 3.0.0.

name: find_channels
